age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years. Upper age relaxation of up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Women and physically challenged candidates.

qualification.details: B.E./B.Tech. in Biotechnology/Industrial Biotechnology/Bioinformatics/Biotech. Engineering/Bioengineering/Biological Sciences and Bioengineering/Biosciences and Bioengineering/Biotechnology and Biochemical Engineering/Biochemical and Biotechnology Engineering, and M.E./M.Tech./M.S.(by Research)/M.S.* (from abroad, two-year program only) in Biotechnology/Industrial Biotechnology/Bioinformatics/Biotech Engineering/Genetic Engineering/Biological Sciences and Bioengineering/Biosciences and Bioengineering/Biotechnology and Biochemical Engineering/Biochemical and Biotechnology Engineering/Environmental Engineering. (OR) M.Sc. in Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Botany/Zoology/Bioinformatics/Life Sciences and M.Tech. in Biotechnology/M.Tech in Environmental Engineering. (OR) M.Sc. in Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Botany/Zoology/Bioinformatics/Life Sciences. Minimum 60% aggregate marks or 6.5 CGPA at both UG and PG for GEN/GEN-EWS/OBC-NCL category and minimum 55% aggregate marks or 6.0 CGPA at both UG and PG for SC/ST/PwD category. Candidates with Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology with at least CGPA of 7.5/10 or 70% of marks under GEN/GEN-EWS/OBC-NCL category and at least CGPA of 7.0/10 or 65% under SC/ST/PwD category. Candidates with GATE/CSIR-UGC/DBT/ICMR NET qualification will be given preference.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Warangal JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Warangal is 03 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position announced by NIT Warangal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications include B.E./B.Tech., M.E./M.Tech./M.S., or M.Sc. degrees in relevant fields like Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, etc.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the JRF position is 30 years, with age relaxation applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will be based on an Interview, which can be conducted either online or offline.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the NIT Warangal JRF position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. Does NIT Warangal offer any age relaxation for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, NIT Warangal offers an upper age relaxation of up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Women and physically challenged candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information.
